correctness.rationale: Proved the exact conditional count-to-area regression using conditional uniform event times, Var(J)=lambda/3 from Poisson integration, and global integer-threshold sufficiency by nearest-center reassignment. Uniform finite-Poisson tail estimates establish exact max attainment. The sharp normal bound 2/pi follows from an explicit double-integral cosh inequality with strict equality only at zero. W2 continuity of two-level distortion plus Poisson CLT yields uniform large-rate design convergence; standardized cutoff tightness and normal threshold uniqueness prove centering for every optimal cutoff representative. The packaged standard-library verification passed 1182 direct finite-law and bounded-grid checks, expressly not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The natural one-bit sensing budget is motivated by quantized photon/count observation and integrated-arrival path reconstruction, rather than an arbitrary numerical slice. The exact finite-intensity formula enables joint location/cutoff optimization. Its high-rate 16/(9π) captured-variance frontier and convergence of every optimal site to 2/3 give a sharp global design law, distinguishing properly centered bit quantization from fixed presence indicators that lose almost all area information at high intensity. No downstream theorem is required for the precise bit-budget benchmark.
